title: Feature Launch Mosaic — Readiness Dossier & KPI Sentinel
body:
Purpose:
This dossier is the single-source product-ops handoff for the Mosaic feature launch. It combines a compact roadmap mosaic (lane tiles), the KPI sentinel (leading + lagging signals), readiness checkpoints, and explicit contingency runcards. Use this doc during the pre-launch gate, launch-day ops, and the 72-hour post-launch review.

Scope:
- Feature: Mosaic (multi-model routing + per-customer caching layer)
- Release type: staged canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 7 days
- Platforms: Hosted API + Dedicated (US-EAST + EU-WEST)

Quick summary (one-line):
Mosaic enables routing by customer policy and model-cost tier with graceful fallback and per-tenant cache; watch cost/unit and error surface during first 72h.

Mosaic Roadmap Mosaic (lane tiles):
- Lane: SDK & API (tile owner: Marco Liu) — required API v2, streaming consistency, function-calling contract. Target: GA by day 7 post-canary.
- Lane: Serving Runtime (tile owner: Priya Singh) — routing tiers, model variant compatibility table. Target: validation complete before canary.
- Lane: Console & Ops (tile owner: Jordan Kim) — rollout controls + per-route dashboards. Target: dashboards live before canary.
- Lane: Billing & Quotas (tile owner: Felix Ortega) — per-tenant billing mapping + rate-limits. Target: soft quotas active at canary.

Readiness checklist (pre-canary gate) — must be green or have documented mitigations:
- API spec signed off and client examples updated (owner: Marco)
- Canaries defined (10k requests/day min) and infra reserved (owner: Priya)
- Dashboards: latency/cost/error + burn-rate panels created (owner: Jordan)
- Billing sanity test: synthetic tenant with quota mapping (owner: Felix)
- Security review & threat model signoff (security reviewer: Keenan Wu)
- Rollback runbook written and tested (owner: Marco)
- Legal/compliance checklist (for EU data residency) completed (owner: Legal Ops)

KPI Sentinel (primary signals + thresholds) — alarms feed Ops channel:
Leading indicators (watch closely during canary):
- Avg tokens per session (expected 120–420). Spike > 2x baseline -> investigate prompt loop.
- Request error rate (4xx/5xx) — threshold: >1.5% sustained over 5m triggers prebake.
- Model fallback rate (percent of requests triggering fallback variant) — threshold: >8% triggers throttles.
- Median cold-start latency (ms) — threshold: >250ms per upstream pool
- Cost per 1k tokens (USD) — threshold: +40% vs baseline -> evaluate routing config

Lagging indicators (post-hoc metrics for launch health):
- Activation conversion (new customers using Mosaic features) — weekly target 12% of invited cohort
- Retention of feature users at 7d -> baseline 58%
- Total monthly cost delta for canary cohort < 18% of projected budget

SLOs & Acceptance Criteria for canary->scale decision:
- P95 request latency for Mosaic-enabled routes < 700ms
- Error rate sustained < 0.8% over 30m after warm-up window
- No data-exfil events; zero privacy incidents logged
- Observability: complete traces and token-level cost attribution present for 100% of sampled requests

Canary cadence and escalation plan:
- Hour 0–3: 2% traffic. Ops on high-alert. Live message on #launch-ops.
- Hour 4–12: 10% traffic if leading indicators stable. Product ops does first triage.
- Day 1–3: 10% -> 10% sustained with incremental feature toggles off/on per tile. Weekly exec snapshot if stable.
- Day 4–7: 50% -> 100% staged only if cost and error budgets hold.

Escalation matrix (who to ping first):
- On-call SRE -> primary pager (SRE rotation)
- Product ops lead -> Aisha Patel (this doc owner)
- Serving runtime owner -> Priya Singh
- Console ops owner -> Jordan Kim
- Billing owner -> Felix Ortega

Contingency runcards (fast rollback & soft-fail strategies):
- Symptom: model routing causing cost spike. Action: flip routing policy to `tiered-prob` -> reduce heavy-model routing to 20%. Owner: Priya.
- Symptom: error rate increases > 2% sustained. Action: pause Mosaic routing and route to baseline model pool; enable automatic retries with jitter off. Owner: SRE on-call.
- Symptom: per-tenant SLA violation. Action: move affected tenants to Dedicated fallback pool and open P1 ticket; notify AE/CS. Owner: Felix + CS lead.
- Symptom: telemetry gaps (missing traces/cost attribution). Action: fail open to baseline, start telemetry recovery play; avoid further scaling. Owner: Jordan.

Operational runbook snippets (copy into runbook system):
- How to force a tenant into fallback pool (CLI + Console steps)
- How to disable Mosaic routing globally (feature-flag steps)
- How to re-run quota accounting for affected billing window
- How to collect a diagnostic bundle for a sample session (logs, trace, token map)

Stakeholder cadence & communications:
- Pre-canary readout (2 business days before): SLT + Eng + SRE + CS — 30m sync (owner: Aisha)
- Canary daily digest (Days 0–3): automated digest to #launch-ops and exec summary to product leadership at EOD
- 72-hour war room (if anomaly persists): live triage with teams listed in escalation matrix
- Post-launch 7-day lessons learned: documented in confluence link in linked_artifacts

Notes and open questions (work-in-progress):
- Need a clearer definition of acceptable "model fallback" for customers on Dedicated vs Hosted. (Action: Priya to draft by 2024-11-14)
- Validate cost simulation for extreme prompt lengths (>2k tokens) with the bench test harness (Action: Marco)
- Confirm that billing export includes per-tenant routing tag (Action: Felix)

Appendix: quick checkpoints for go/no-go poll on launch day (one-liners for exec):
- Are canary leading indicators within thresholds? (Y/N)
- Any open P1s related to Mosaic? (Y/N)
- Observability ingest rates stable (no telemetry drop)?
- Cost projection for next 7 days within budget?

Document history and notes:
- 2024-11-08: Drafted by Aisha Patel after product sync
- 2024-11-10: Added escalation matrix and contingency runcards (inputs from SRE)
- 2024-11-12: Dashboard links and canary cadence updated (Jordan)

Action items (short):
- Marco: update quickstart examples and SDK changelog (due 2024-11-14)
- Priya: finalize routing compatibility matrix and stress test (due 2024-11-15)
- Jordan: publish dashboard links and alert playbooks (due 2024-11-13)
- Felix: run billing export smoke and confirm per-tenant tags (due 2024-11-13)

If you are on the launch rotation and see anything outside the described thresholds, escalate immediately using the Escalation Matrix above and attach the diagnostic bundle to JIRA-PROD-4182.

- End of dossier -
